Imaging & Vision Applications

Imaging and advanced computer vision solutions have been enabling key innovations in a variety of use cases. Starting from factory automation (FA), the field is expanding to security surveillance, automotive, medical diagnostics, agriculture automation, and more.

textwithimage_1.text:
High-speed inspection

High-speed cameras are used to sort defects and abnormalities in manufacturing lines in a very high-speed moving environment. Typically global shutter image sensors with high frame rate is required to accurately capture the images of products without distortion.

  • Sony Global Shutter CMOS Sensors: Ideal for distortion-free capture of fast motion lines and parts
  • Canon High-Resolution CMOS Sensors: For detailed inspection and defect detection
  • Toppan ToF Depth Sensors/Cameras: For 3D object measurement, volume calculation, and spatial mapping tasks

Vision-guided robotics

Robots are taking over more complex manufacturing processes with the help of advanced vision solutions. Multi-axis robots can move their arms and hands like humans and see the subject using cameras and analytics & control software to guide the movement necessary to accomplish the tasks in the manufacturing process more efficiently and accurately.

  • Sony CMOS and Global Shutter Families: For accurate motion capture and object recognition
  • Toppan 3D ToF Sensors: Supporting robot navigation, obstacle avoidance, and pose estimation
  • Canon CMOS Sensors: When high-resolution imaging is needed in robot perception systems

Wide-area inspection and quality control

For scanning complex products over wide areas, such as inspecting solder joints on printed circuit boards, high-resolution advanced imaging solutions are the ideal technology. These systems leverage high-resolution image sensors to capture precise, detailed scans in a single shot, enabling efficient detection of defects or abnormalities in the manufacturing process.

  • Sony High-Resolution CMOS and Global Shutter Sensors: For precise defect detection and measurement
  • Canon Ultra-High-Resolution CMOS Sensors: Enabling fine detail capture at large pixel counts

Self-learning AI for real-time threat detection

Security teams face thousands of cameras and millions of video frames each day, making it easy to miss real threats. icetana transforms existing CCTV systems into proactive security tools by analyzing unusual activity and threats in real time and learning what is normal for each scene within days. Without complex setup, it detects loitering, sudden gatherings, or erratic movement, helping teams focus on credible risks. By filtering routine footage and elevating genuine threats, icetana reduces false alerts, speeds response, and protects people, property, and reputation.

Learn more

Outdoor surveillance camera

Security cameras operating outdoor often need to tolerate both extremely bright light that can cause the image to blowout in the daytime and extremely low light situations in the night time that require high sensitivity of the sensors. To cope with the very wide dynamic range of lighting, camera's image processing component needs to be equipped with mechanisms called high dynamic range (HDR).

  • Sony STARVIS / Low-Light CMOS Sensors: For high sensitivity and low-noise capture
  • Canon CMOS Sensors: For advanced imaging in surveillance system

Dashcam

Dashcams need to record scenes of driving in various conditions in light dynamics to capture necessary information to prove causes of accidents and license plate numbers. Image sensors need to be highly sensitive while providing high dynamic range capabilities for the camera processing engine.

  • Sony CMOS Sensors: High dynamic range and low-light performance for day/night driving conditions, glare mitigation, and fast scene transitions
  • Canon CMOS Sensors: High-resolution capture for evidentiary detail, license plate readability, and wide-FOV imaging
  • Toppan 3D ToF Sensors: Depth sensing for driver monitoring, in-cabin awareness, and advanced safety features

Broadcast camera

Typically, broadcast camera's product life cycle is longer than consumer products and anyone designing for it need to consider longer product life of its components too. Macnica offers various components with industrial product life.

  • Sony CMOS and Global Shutter Sensors: High dynamic range, low noise, and accurate color reproduction for live production and studio environments
  • Canon CMOS Sensors: Large-format and high-sensitivity imaging for cinematic capture, broadcast, and professional video systems

Digital pathology systems

Digital pathology platforms leverage advanced imaging, AI, and cloud-based technologies to digitize and analyze pathology slides. These advanced computer vision solutions convert glass slides into high-resolution digital images using specialized scanners, enabling pathologists to view, annotate, and share slides remotely.

  • Canon High-Sensitivity CMOS Sensors: Supporting medical imaging, microscopy, and low-light diagnostic imaging

Robotic surgery systems

Robotic surgery systems are advanced platforms that enhance surgical precision, flexibility, and control through robotic arms, cameras, and specialized tools. They are often controlled by surgeons via a console that translates hand movements into micro-precise actions. Imaging and vision technologies are indispensable in robotic surgery, providing the surgeon with augmented capabilities to perform complex procedures with unprecedented accuracy.

  • Sony CMOS Sensors: Used for precision machine vision in medical devices

UAVs

Unmanned aerial vehicles (UAV) are used in agriculture in various ways; to assess the growth and health of crops, to analyze soil moisture and topography, to manage irrigation, and so on. Imaging and vision systems play great roles in collecting visual and spectral data for accurate analysis.

  • Sony CMOS Sensors: High dynamic range and low-light performance for aerial imaging and mapping
  • Canon CMOS Sensors: Ultra-high-resolution imaging for surveying, inspection, and geospatial analysis
  • Toppan 3D ToF Sensors: Depth perception and obstacle awareness for navigation and situational awareness

Crop sorting and grading systems

Advanced computer vision solution technologies are used to automate sorting crops and grading fruits, vegetables and grains based on size, color, and quality. For speed and accuracy, image sensors need to high-speed, high-frame rate, and wide-spectral range. In the grading application, polarized sensors are useful in capturing dents and scars more effectively.

  • Sony High-Speed CMOS Sensors: Rapid capture for color, shape, and defect detection on high-throughput lines
  • Canon CMOS Sensors: Accurate color reproduction and fine detail analysis for grading and quality assessment
  • Toppan 3D ToF Sensors: Size, volume, and surface profiling for consistent grading

How does Macnica help you design imaging and vision products?

Advanced imaging and vision solutions must connect to other components using one of several competing interface standards. Macnica makes connection simple by providing the basic engineering required to evaluate, and then implement the best interface for a given need. We offer image sensors, image processing components, intellectual property packages for interface, control and analytics software, and a hardware development kit perfect for imaging and vision product development, in addition to the design services to bring your ideas to production.
Macnica supplies leading image sensors from Sony, Canon, and Toppan as an official distributor for the Americas with technical support and design services capabilities.

Sony Image Sensors

Sony’s CMOS image sensors define performance in industrial and embedded vision with high sensitivity, low noise, and advanced pixel architectures. Our Sony portfolio includes global shutter and rolling shutter CMOS devices, high dynamic range sensors, event-based vision sensors, SWIR imaging, and depth sensing variants - delivering unmatched clarity, speed, and robustness for demanding vision systems.

Canon CMOS Sensors

Canon’s CMOS image sensors bring exceptional imaging performance to industrial and scientific vision applications. From ultra-high-resolution and high-pixel-count sensors to large-pixel, high-sensitivity designs and global shutter options, Canon sensors expand possibilities in high-precision inspection, low-light imaging, and advanced machine vision system design.

Toppan 3D ToF Sensing Solutions

Toppan’s 3D Time-of-Flight (ToF) sensing technology delivers precise depth and spatial perception across robotics, automation, AMRs, and advanced system safety applications. With high frame rates, strong ambient-light tolerance, and accurate 3D data capture, Toppan ToF modules complement 2D imaging to enable true hybrid vision solutions.
